name: s020_ops_focus
description: The peak of s018 in detail: with the rod recessed so that the Cs+ focus lands on the silicon, the cup current rises about tenfold but within about 0.5 mm of depth. Target in 0.25 mm steps around the focus for V_c 6 (-9 to -11 mm), 8 (-7 to -9) and 10 kV (-6.5 to -8.5), 19 kV extraction, supply above the space-charge limit, with twice the Cs+ and Si- particles of s018 (N_cs 6000, N_si 10000), so that the sampling noise can be judged against s018; scored at the cup as s015.
